paite: Huchi in Judah mi tengteng in kum sawm-le-guk a upa Uzziah api ua, apa Amaziah sik in kumpipa ding in abawlta uhi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Uzziah / (2 Kum 14.21,22; 15.1-7)

paite: Ama'n kumpipa api-le-pute kiang a a-ihmut nung in Eloth khua abawlhoih a, Judah gam ah apangsak nawn hi.
Uzziah in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawm-le-guk a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga-le-nih vai ahawm a, anu min Jekoliah, Jerusalem mi ahi.
Apa Amaziah thilhih bangbang hih sam in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoihtak ahih zel hi.
Pathian kilakna theisiam Zekariah damsung in Pathian zong ding in akibawl tinten hi. Pathian azon sung teng in Pathian in alamzangsak hi.
Philistiate sim ding in akuankhia a, Gath kulhte, Jabneh kulh, Ashdod kulh ahihchim a; huchi in Ashdod gam ah leh Philistiate lak ah khua abawl hi.
Huchi in Pathian in Philistiate lak ah leh Gurbaal a om Arabiate leh Meuni mite lak ah apanpih hi.
Ammonte'n Uzziah lak ah siah aliau sek ua; huchi in ahong hat mahmah ziak un Aigupta gam tan in aminthangta uhi.
Uzziah in Jerusalem ah aning ah kongpi, Phaizang kongpi, kulh kawina lai kongpi, insangte, alam lai a, kulh in a-um hi.

Gamdai ah leng insang alam a, gam tampi aneih ziak in tuilehte atoukhia a, phailam leh phaizang ah ganhon anei a; lounei mite leh uain suk mite tang lam leh gam hoihte ah akoih a, amah louma lam limsakmi tak ahi.
Uzziah in sepaih kidoumi kumpipa sepaih heutu Hanani nuai a mi laigelhmi Jeiel leh heutu Maaseiahte'n aseh bang zel ua apawlpawl a galkapmi anei lai hi.
Mihat hangsan chiat, a-inkuan upate tengteng sangnih-le-zaguk ahi uh.
Anuai uah sepaih sinsiamsa ngen nuaithum sangsagih-le-zanga melma lak a kumpipa panpihmi galsualmi taktak a-om uhi.
Huchi in Uzziah in sepaih tengteng a ding in lum, tei, sik lukhu, sik puanak, thalpeu leh vaisuanglot a ding in suangte akisakhol hi.

Jerusalem ah mipilte theihkhiak khawlte abawl a, insang leh kulh ning chih ah thalkapna leh suang lian kuamkuam ana denna ding akoih a; amin gam chih mual chih ah athangta a; ahat mahmah tan in alam a lamdangtak a panpih in a-om hi.
Himahleh ahong hat nung in alungsim ahong sang a, hoih lou hial in thil ahih a, TOUPA a Pathian tung ah thil ahihkhial a; gimlim maitam a gimlim hal ding in TOUPA tempul ah alut hi.
heading: Uzziah Sawi A Omna

paite: Huchi in siampu Azariah in azui a, mihangsantak TOUPA siampu sawmgiat atel uhi.

Kumpipa Uzziah akhou ua akiang ah, "Uzziah aw, TOUPA a ding a gimlim hal nang hih ding ahi kei, gimlim hal ding a sehtuam Aaron tapa siampute hih ding ahi zaw hi; mun siangthou a kipan pawtkhia in; thil na hihkhial hi; TOUPA Pathian a pan na thupina ding ahi kei," achi uhi.
Huan Uzziah ahehta a; gimlim halna ding mei lakna atawi a, huchi a siampute tung a aheh laitak in TOUPA' inn ah, gimlim halna chin ah siampute ma ah atal ahong phakkheta hi.
Huchi in siampu heutu Azariah leh siampu tengteng in a-en ua, ngai in, atal ahong phak a, huai a kipan in avikkhe pah ua, ahi, TOUPA'N agawt ziak in amah leng kintak in apawtkheta hi.

Kumpipa Uzziah bel asih ni tan in aphakta a, aphak ziak in a-inn tuam ah a-omta hi. TOUPA' inn a kipan hihkhiak in a-omta a, huchi in atapa Jotham bel agam ua mite vaihawm in kumpipa' inn a ukpa ding in a-omta hi.
Uzziah thilhih dang tengteng bel abul a kipan a atawp pha in Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai in agelh hi.
Huchi in Uzziah bel api leh apute kiang ah a-ihmu a, kumpipa kivuina mun a api leh apute lak ah avui uhi. "Amah zaw phak ahi ngal a," achi ua, huchi in asik in atapa Jotham in vai ahawmta hi.
